lines.en: I tramp across the steel plates of the floor.
My joints lift one section at a time, slowly.
My weight makes the floor sag.
A vent coughs out white vapor.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都折了。
lines.en: Grass folds where I pass.
One step of mine covers three of yours.

lines.zh: 机壳上的旧划痕在反光。
lines.en: Old scratches on my hull catch the light.
I roll a shoulder axis and hear it grind.

lines.zh: 我踏过碎石，声音像敲钟。
lines.en: I step on rubble and it tolls.
I keep to walls and avoid narrow doors.
I stand, heat sinks open.

lines.zh: 液压里传来低低的声音。
lines.en: A low hum runs through my hydraulics.

lines.zh: 我是这系列最早的一台。
lines.en: I'm the earliest unit in this series.

lines.zh: 我身上没有驾驶舱的人。
lines.en: There's no pilot in my cockpit.
I count the clicks of my own joints.
This generation is still in testing.
I settle my center of gravity lower.
My optic sweeps a full circle.

lines.zh: 我记不清被造出来多久了。
lines.en: I can't recall how long ago I was built.
I don't breathe. I use fans.

lines.zh: 我的板甲上落了一层锈。
lines.en: A layer of rust has settled on my plates.
I wait for orders, or for an opponent.

lines.zh: 我转了转手腕，齿轮咬紧。
lines.en: I rotate a wrist; the gears bite.
No loot table was written into me.
Standing still, I'm a small tower.
You're much shorter than me.

lines.zh: 我的目镜在测你的距离。
lines.en: My optic is measuring your distance.
You don't smell of metal.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我先动了。
lines.en: When you look up, I move first.
What you're holding is too light.
I wasn't built to negotiate.

lines.zh: 我的引擎声，比你脚步先到。
lines.en: My engine reaches you before my feet.

lines.zh: 我在算你的骨架能撑几下。
lines.en: I'm calculating how many hits your frame takes.
You stand firm. Good.

lines.zh: 我是被唤醒的，不是自然生成。
lines.en: I was awakened, not naturally spawned.

lines.zh: 你的影子只有我的脚掌大。
lines.en: Your shadow is only the size of my foot.
A new dent in my hull.

lines.zh: 液压油从裂缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Hydraulic oil seeps from the crack.
That one got into a seam.
My heat sink is bent.
A light on my panel turned red.
I can still move. No need to worry.
I recalibrate.
The damage is within tolerance.
I don't take food.

lines.zh: 你举的东西，我要它做什么？
lines.en: What would I do with that?
Metal doesn't eat grass.
You're talking to a machine.

lines.zh: 那点东西，不够我一颗螺丝。
lines.en: That's worth less than one of my bolts.
Bring something useful instead.
You can't coax me.

lines.zh: 别拿零食晃，我的炮口不认人。
lines.en: Don't wave snacks at me — my cannon doesn't care.
You hit me like hitting a pier.
Not a dent in my hull.
My feet didn't shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 我的关节替你挡了一下。
lines.en: My joint took the blow for you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚背，快让开。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. Move.

lines.zh: 这点撞击传不到我里面。
lines.en: That impact never reaches inside me.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪了挪，地板响。
lines.en: I shift my weight; the floor complains.
Don't press against me; you'll get pinched.
Bump me again and I'll turn around.

lines.zh: 另一台在同一条装配线上。
lines.en: Another unit from the same assembly line.
Our serials differ by one digit.
It carries one layer less armor.
We synced our clocks.
No language, only signals.

lines.zh: 它敲了敲我的肩甲，算招呼。
lines.en: It knocks on my pauldron in greeting.
Different tasks, different routes.
It leaves first; its steps carry far.
Next sync may be on a battlefield.
I bend, joints rattling the whole way.
I pinch up what's on the ground.

lines.zh: 这枚珍珠，比我的螺丝小。
lines.en: This pearl is smaller than my bolts.
I stuff it into an access port.
I keep what falls.
I grip it with two mechanical fingers.
I can't feel that weight at all.

lines.zh: 它在我掌心里转了一圈。
lines.en: It rolls once in my palm.
Done, I stand as before.
This counts as a spoil.
I fix my optic on you.

lines.zh: 你触发了我的战斗程序。
lines.en: You've triggered my combat routine.
After this step, no turning back.
I raise an arm; the joints lock.
Don't run; my stride is long.
I've waited long enough for this.
You're flagged as priority.
My hand is already in position.
No retreat at the wall. Good.

lines.zh: 测试阶段的东西，别小看。
lines.en: Don't underestimate something still in testing.
I'll use full power here.

lines.zh: 你听见液压加压的声音吗？
lines.en: Hear the hydraulics charging?

lines.zh: 从我这里开始算，你只有几秒。
lines.en: From now, you have seconds.
I've stepped on your shadow.
Range closing; weapons ready.
Standing firm won't help.

lines.zh: 我的关节全部预热完毕。
lines.en: All my joints are warmed up.
No holding back this time.

lines.zh: 你换了位置，我的目镜跟着转。
lines.en: You moved; my optic tracks.
I press along the wall.
No rush; one step is three.
Behind a door? The door's too thin.

lines.zh: 我的散热口一直对着你。
lines.en: My vents stay aimed at you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声有回音，很好找。
lines.en: Your steps echo. Easy to find.
I hear you drawing breath.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，钢板一路响。
lines.en: I close in; the plates ring.
You've backed to the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 我的重量不允许我快，可我不停。
lines.en: My weight forbids speed, not persistence.

lines.zh: 你的箭打在我壳上，掉了。
lines.en: Your arrow struck my shell and fell.

lines.zh: 我在算你还有几步空间。
lines.en: I'm computing your remaining ground.
This frame doesn't tire.
You're cornered. Corners are smaller.
I raise my hand over your head.

lines.zh: 你还有一条路，我不打算让。
lines.en: One route left. I won't yield it.
I keep watching without blinking.
I'm nearly there.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整台机器的重量。
lines.en: That carried the whole machine's weight.
Your shield dents inward.
I sweep my arm across.
You're knocked back five steps.
My mechanical fingers close on you.
The joints drive all the way down.
I waited three seconds for that.
Your armor cracks loudly.
I haven't used half my power.
I lift a foot; your shadow is gone.
This punch dented the steel plate.

lines.zh: 蒸汽从我的肩甲喷出来。
lines.en: Steam bursts from my pauldron.

lines.zh: 我的液压臂压住你的背。
lines.en: My hydraulic arm pins your back.

lines.zh: 我落地时，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: I land and the ground collapses.

lines.zh: 目镜亮起来，我看见了世界。
lines.en: My optic lights; I see the world.

lines.zh: 蒸汽先喷出来，然后是我。
lines.en: First the steam, then me.

lines.zh: 这具机体还在测试阶段。
lines.en: This frame is still in testing.
I raise an arm to check the joints.
I straighten up. My height is alarming.
There's no assembly line here.
My serial is zero five.
Who pressed the start button?
I rotate my neck axis.

lines.zh: 我身上落着灰，很久没动了。
lines.en: Dust lies on me; I haven't moved in a while.
I scan; no threats.
I'm standing. Awaiting orders.

lines.zh: 这台机器的重量，地面记住了。
lines.en: The ground remembers my weight.

lines.zh: 面板上全是这个世界的尘。
lines.en: My panels are covered in this world's dust.
My joints need exercise.
I was called, so there must be an opponent.

lines.zh: 我的脚下，草没有一根是直的。
lines.en: Not one blade of grass stands under me.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的外壳，只是变热。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell. That's all.

lines.zh: 落地时我的缓冲器到底了。
lines.en: My shock absorbers bottom out on landing.

lines.zh: 水进不去，可我在往下沉。
lines.en: Water can't get in, but I'm sinking.
The shockwave shoves me sideways.
A round jams in my shoulder seam.

lines.zh: 不知名的能量窜进电路。
lines.en: Unknown energy races into my circuits.
Power low. Servos slowing.
The strike runs around my hull.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，陀螺仪失了准。
lines.en: I fall; my gyros lose their reference.
